The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the zephyr is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The terrace is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tundra.
